verdicts.why: MCU Wiki: on Ulysses' death Verussa 'became the leader of his cabal of monster hunters' and runs the hunt in Werewolf by Night; the Monster Hunting Cabal is an Organization page listing her as former leader (she dies in the same title, not a move). Name given plainly by the wiki.

MCU Wiki infobox: affiliation Council of Godheads, title 'Leader of Council of Godheads'; the Council page names him leader, and he presides over it in Omnipotence City in Thor: Love and Thunder. Being stabbed and surviving is not a move.

MCU Wiki: Cassandra Nova's Henchmen (also Cassandra's Militia) were 'a group of variants assembled by Cassandra Nova in the Void', with her as leader; her infobox affiliation is that group. Same name already accepted for Lady Deathstrike, Sabretooth, Toad etc. in apply2.json; her death is not a move.

MCU Wiki: President Loki commanded the Loki Bandits (name from The Art of Loki), then his own army betrayed him in episode 5 and the group is listed Defunct with him as former leader, so the group disbands in the same title. Needs left = ['Loki S1'] for the Independent stage.

MCU Wiki: Surtur is 'Lord of Muspelheim' (citizenship Muspelheim) and rules it from his throne when Thor is held there in Thor: Ragnarok; a realm's ruler counts like Laufey's 'Jotunheim'. His death is not a move.

MCU Wiki infobox affiliation Morgan le Fay's Coven; in Runaways S3 she leads the coven from the Essex Tower Hotel and inducts Nico (whose record already uses "Morgan's coven"). Banishment to the Dark Dimension is not a departure.

MCU Wiki: after Cottonmouth's death Diamondback 'took the command of the Stokes Crime Family members', using Harlem's Paradise as HQ and taking over Cottonmouth's organization in Luke Cage S1; his arrest at season end is not a move.

SSU Wiki: after Nikolai's death Dmitri 'took over his position in the criminal empire' and a year later tells Sergei he has taken over their father's empire (Kraven the Hunter); infobox affiliation Kravinoff Criminal Empire, the name given plainly by the wiki. Before that he was only a pianist at the club.

Marvel Database: in 'To Catch a Spider' (1x19A, the record's episode 19) Noah Boddy frees Electro, Green Goblin and Vulture and 'they formed the team known as the Spider-Catcher'; the team page lists him as a former member, status Defunct, dissolved in that same episode after Spider-Man turns them on each other. Needs left = ['Spider-Man (1967)'].

Marvel Database team page Spider-Catchers (Earth-6799): Vulture is a former member of the team Boddy forms in 1x19A (the record's episode 19), status Defunct with first and last appearance in that episode; he acts alone again in episode 40. Needs left = ['Spider-Man (1967)'].

Marvel Database team page Spider-Catchers (Earth-6799): Electro is a former member of the team Boddy forms in 1x19A (the record's episode 19), which dissolves in that episode (status Defunct). Needs left = ['Spider-Man (1967)'].

X-Men Movies Wiki: Ajax is 'the leader of the Workshop program', 'a top-secret illegal research organization' (subsidiary of Weapon X) that sells mutated test subjects as slaves; he runs it throughout Deadpool until his death. An illegal organization like Weapon X, not an ordinary workplace.

X-Men Movies Wiki: Angel Dust is 'a high-ranking member of the Workshop program' and Ajax's right hand, still running it with him a year later in Deadpool; infobox affiliation The Workshop. Being knocked out at the end is not a move.

X2 service is under Stryker's mind control (not membership). MCU Wiki: the Void variant 'became one of Cassandra Nova's henchmen' and fights in the assault on the lair in Deadpool & Wolverine; infobox affiliation Cassandra Nova's Henchmen. Matches the value already in apply2.json.

MCU Wiki: Blob 'became one of Cassandra Nova's henchmen', placed in charge of opening the compound gate, and is killed by Blade's rocket in Deadpool & Wolverine (his only title); infobox affiliation Cassandra Nova's Henchmen. Death is not a move.

Marvel Database lists Boddy as the team's leader 'Formerly', status Defunct, dissolved in 1x19A (the record's episode 19), so he needs the same-title departure his three members get (a multi-stage list uses the title, not '(from the start)'). Needs left = ['Spider-Man (1967)'].

Marvel Database: Nathaniel Richards 'arrived in ancient Egypt, where he used his futuristic technology to become the pharaoh known as Rama-Tut' (X-Men '97 S2E3, record ep 13), and after losing the Ship 'considered his efforts in the Ancient Egypt complete and departed that time period' (ep 14). Ruler of a nation, like Grandmaster/Sakaar. Needs left = ["X-Men '97"].

MCU Wiki: the Collector 'is the head of the Tivan Group', the galaxy's most powerful criminal-underworld group, with the Black Order as his security (What If...? episode 2); the Tivan Group page names him leader. Unlike Carina (a slave, rejected), he leads it; his capture is not a departure.
